nat = "/work/build-baseline/tmp/work/cortexa57-poky-linux/libwebsockets/4.2.2-r0/recipe-sysroot-native"

src_bld = pathlib.Path("/work/build-baseline/tmp/work/cortexa57-poky-linux/libwebsockets/4.2.2-r0/build")
cc = f"{nat}/usr/bin/aarch64-poky-linux/aarch64-poky-linux-gcc"

    shutil.copytree(src_git, w / "git", symlinks=True)
    shutil.copytree(src_bld, w / "build", symlinks=True)
    # Fix path references in CMake/ninja? Faster & cleaner: recompile just hpack.c.o or parsers.c.o and relink libwebsockets.so.18!
    cmd_db = (src_bld / "build.ninja").read_text()
    if patch_kind == "eq":
        hp = w / "git/lib/roles/h2/hpack.c"
        t = hp.read_text()
        old = "static int lws_frag_append(struct lws *wsi, unsigned char c)\n{\n\tstruct allocated_headers *ah = wsi->http.ah;\n\n\tah->data[ah->pos++] = (char)c;"

argv:
import hashlib, json, re, shutil, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
import pexpect

def sha(p):
    with open(p, "rb") as f:
        return hashlib.file_digest(f, "sha256").hexdigest()

qemu = "/work/build-baseline/tmp/work/aarch64-linux/qemu-helper-native/1.0-r1/recipe-sysroot-native/usr/bin/qemu-system-aarch64"
variants = [
    ("baseline", "/work/build-baseline/tmp/deploy/images/qemuarm64/Image--5.15.211+git0+73e7c4ea36_e3ab4c73da-r0-qemuarm64-20261117213416.bin", "/work/build-baseline/tmp/deploy/images/qemuarm64/firmdura-reference-baseline-qemuarm64-20261118113155.rootfs.ext4"),
    ("patched", "/work/build-patched/tmp/deploy/images/qemuarm64/Image--5.15.211+git0+73e7c4ea36_e3ab4c73da-r0-qemuarm64-20261117213416.bin", "/work/build-patched/tmp/deploy/images/qemuarm64/firmdura-reference-patched-qemuarm64-20261118120234.rootfs.ext4"),
]
out = {}
for name, kernel, rootfs in variants:
    before = {"kernel": sha(kernel), "rootfs": sha(rootfs)}
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=f"reg-{name}-") as td:
        copy = Path(td) / "rootfs.ext4"
        shutil.copyfile(rootfs, copy)
        cmd = [
            "-machine", "virt", "-cpu", "cortex-a57", "-smp", "2", "-m", "512",
            "-nographic", "-nic", "none", "-kernel", kernel,
            "-drive", f"id=disk0,file={copy},if=none,format=raw",
            "-device", "virtio-blk-pci,drive=disk0",
            "-object", "rng-random,filename=/dev/urandom,id=rng0",
            "-device", "virtio-rng-pci,rng=rng0",
            "-device", "virtio-serial-pci", "-chardev", "null,id=virtcon",
            "-device", "virtconsole,chardev=virtcon",
            "-append", "console=ttyAMA0 root=/dev/vda rw",
        ]
        child = pexpect.spawn(qemu, cmd, encoding="utf-8", timeout=120)
        seq = 0
        def guest(c):
            nonlocal seq
            seq += 1
            m = f"__REG_RC_{seq}__="
            child.sendline(c + f"; rc=$?; printf '\n{m}%s\n' "$rc"")
            child.expect(re.escape(m) + r"([0-9]+)\r*\n", timeout=30)
            rc = int(child.match.group(1))
            txt = child.before.replace("\r", "")
            child.expect_exact("__REG_PROMPT__ ", timeout=30)
            if rc != 0:
                raise RuntimeError(f"{name}: command failed ({rc}): {c}\n{txt}")
            return txt
        try:
            child.expect("qemuarm64 login:")
            child.sendline("root")
            child.expect(r"root@qemuarm64:[^\r\n]*# ")
            child.sendline("export PS1='__REG_PROMPT__ '")
            child.expect(r"\r*\n__REG_PROMPT__ ")
            guest("ifconfig lo 127.0.0.1 up || ip link set lo up")
            lejp = guest("libwebsockets-test-lejp </usr/share/libwebsockets-test-server/test.html >/tmp/lejp.out 2>&1 || libwebsockets-test-lejp --help >/tmp/lejp.out 2>&1; test -s /tmp/lejp.out")
            transfer = guest(
                "libwebsockets-test-server -i lo -p 7681 -r /usr/share/libwebsockets-test-server -d 7 >/tmp/srv.log 2>&1 & spid=$!; "
                "sleep 1; wget -q -O /tmp/fetched-leaf.jpg http://127.0.0.1:7681/leaf.jpg && "
                "orig=$(sha256sum /usr/share/libwebsockets-test-server/leaf.jpg | awk '{print $1}') && "
                "got=$(sha256sum /tmp/fetched-leaf.jpg | awk '{print $1}') && "
                "test "$orig" = "$got" && printf 'LEAF_SHA256=%s\n' "$got" && kill "$spid""
            )
            m_sha = re.search(r"LEAF_SHA256=([0-9a-f]{64})", transfer)
            assert m_sha is not None
            child.sendline("poweroff")
            child.expect(pexpect.EOF, timeout=90)
            child.close()
            assert child.exitstatus == 0
        finally:
            child.close(force=True)
            after = {"kernel": sha(kernel), "rootfs": sha(rootfs)}
            assert before == after
        out[name] = {"status": "passed", "leaf_jpg_sha256": m_sha.group(1), "originals_unchanged": True}
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))

commands.label: sti-110-patched-archive-verify
argv:
import hashlib, json, posixpath, tarfile
from pathlib import Path
store = Path('<store>')
path = store / "artifacts/20261118-sti110-patched/deploy.tar"
source = store / "logs/sti-110-patched-deploy-source-hashes.log"
source_root = "/work/build-patched/tmp/deploy/"
entries = [json.loads(line) for line in source.read_text().splitlines()]
expected = {item["path"]: item for item in entries}
absolute_aliases = []
with tarfile.open(path, "r:") as archive:
    members = archive.getmembers()
    names = {member.name.rstrip("/") for member in members}
    actual = {}
    for member in members:
        if member.isdir():
            continue
        if not member.name.startswith("deploy/"):
            raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected archive path: {member.name}")
        relative = member.name[len("deploy/"):]
        if relative in actual:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Duplicate archive path: {relative}")
        actual[relative] = member
    if set(actual) != set(expected):
        raise RuntimeError({"missing": sorted(set(expected) - set(actual)), "extra": sorted(set(actual) - set(expected))})
    for relative, item in expected.items():
        member = actual[relative]
        if item["type"] == "symlink":
            if not member.issym() or member.linkname != item["target"]:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Symlink mismatch: {relative}")
            if member.linkname.startswith(source_root):
                target = "deploy/" + member.linkname[len(source_root):]
                absolute_aliases.append({"path": relative, "target": member.linkname, "archive_member": target})
            else:
                target = posixpath.normpath(posixpath.join(posixpath.dirname(member.name), member.linkname))
            if not target.startswith("deploy/") or target not in names:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Unresolved archive symlink: {relative} -> {target}")
        else:
            if not (member.isfile() or member.islnk()):
                raise RuntimeError(f"File type mismatch: {relative}")
            with archive.extractfile(member) as stream:
                digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
                size = stream.tell()
            if digest != item["sha256"] or size != item["size"]:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Content mismatch: {relative}")
with path.open("rb") as stream:
    archive_digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()

c_src_path = store / "logs/sti-110-patched-component-logs-hashes.log"
c_src = json.loads(c_src_path.read_text())
c_exp = {i["path"]: i for i in c_src["members"]}
c_tar = store / "artifacts/20261118-sti110-patched/libwebsockets-task-logs.tar"
c_seen = set()
with tarfile.open(c_tar, "r:") as tf:
    for m in tf:
        if m.isdir():
            continue
        assert m.name.startswith("temp/")
        rel = m.name[len("temp/"):]
        assert rel not in c_seen and rel in c_exp
        c_seen.add(rel)
        it = c_exp[rel]
        if it["type"] == "file":
            assert m.isfile() and m.size == it["size"]
            with tf.extractfile(m) as s:
                assert hashlib.file_digest(s, "sha256").hexdigest() == it["sha256"]
        else:
            assert m.issym() and m.linkname == it["target"]
assert c_seen == set(c_exp)
with c_tar.open("rb") as s:
    c_sha = hashlib.file_digest(s, "sha256").hexdigest()

res = {
    "deploy_integrity": {
        "status": "verified",
        "files": sum(item["type"] == "file" for item in entries),
        "symlinks": sum(item["type"] == "symlink" for item in entries),
        "logical_file_bytes": sum(item.get("size", 0) for item in entries),
        "archive_size": path.stat().st_size,
        "archive_sha256": archive_digest,
        "source_index_sha256": hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "locator": "local://firmdura-kirkstone/artifacts/20261118-sti110-patched/deploy.tar",
        "directory_export_is_canonical": False,
        "absolute_aliases": absolute_aliases,
        "restore_root": source_root,
        "relocatable_without_alias_handling": False,
    },
    "component_logs_integrity": {
        "status": "verified",
        "archive": "local://firmdura-kirkstone/artifacts/20261118-sti110-patched/libwebsockets-task-logs.tar",
        "archive_size": c_tar.stat().st_size,
        "archive_sha256": c_sha,
        "source_index_sha256": hashlib.sha256(c_src_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "regular_files": sum(i["type"] == "file" for i in c_exp.values()),
        "symlinks": sum(i["type"] == "symlink" for i in c_exp.values()),
        "logical_file_bytes": sum(i["size"] for i in c_exp.values() if i["type"] == "file"),
    },
}
(store / "runs/sti-110-patched-integrity.json").write_text(json.dumps(res, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(res, indent=2))
